summary: Verified Toolkit V-beam escape, power toggle, contact sheet, camera appearance, Filmography sound hooks (expand on open, collapse on close via back/ESC), Toolkit sound chip, YNW regression, and layout overflow. All targeted features work; zero console errors/warnings observed.

verifications.toolkit_power_toggle: tk-section.tk-on toggles true/false; button label flips 'SWITCH ON' <-> 'SWITCH OFF'
verifications.beam_escape_element: `.tk-beam--escape` present with computed z-index:-1, opacity:0.545, height 4849px, top -1675px (above tk-section), clipPath polygon(263.7 2231.2, 1500 1464.7, 1500 3529.3) — wedge extends into both YNW (above) and Filmography (below) as spec'd. Visible in screenshot as a soft diagonal glow fanning right from the lens.
verifications.contact_sheet: 6 numbered film cards (01-06) render with sprockets, titles, taglines; testids toolkit-card-1..5 + Programming Languages card. All readable with beam on.
verifications.camera: Dark obsidian camera body (not washed out) with twin reels, red-glow lens lamp, tripod — matches spec.
verifications.filmography_sounds: openChapter path invoked for spit, spjimr, bakerhughes without console errors; ChapterDetail opens/closes via back-btn and ESC key, no WebAudio exceptions.
verifications.toolkit_sound_chip: `toolkit-sound-toggle` flips SOUND ON <-> SOUND OFF with no console errors.
verifications.ynw_regression: YNW reel element renders; no interference from new beam work.
verifications.overflow: No horizontal overflow at 1440x900 or 390x844 (scrollWidth === innerWidth).
verifications.console: No pageerror / console.error / console.warning events during full flow.

critical_code_review_comments: Beam escape element is 4849px tall with z-index -1 overlapping two sibling sections — fine today, but if any ancestor accidentally gets `overflow:hidden` or a new stacking context (transform/filter/opacity<1) on root/#root, the escape beam will visually collapse back inside .tk-section. Worth a code comment near .tk-beam--escape to warn future edits.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Toolkit beam/sheet/camera and Filmography sound hooks all pass. Previous iterations 1-4 remain green. If future changes touch #root or any .tk-section ancestor styles, re-verify the beam escape element is still visible (z-index -1 relies on root paint-free).
